record.paper_title: Some Open Questions in Analysis for Dirichlet Series
record.original_question: Let F_N(s)=sum_{n=1}^N n^{-s}. Is its H^1 norm little-o of sqrt(N) as N tends to infinity; equivalently, is ||F_N||_{H^1}=o(sqrt(N))?

evidence.quote: Problem 4.1 (Helson’s problem [52]). Is it true that kPN n=1 n−skH1 = o(pN) when N → ∞.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathscr{H}^1$ denote the Hardy space of Dirichlet series defined as the completion of the space of Dirichlet polynomials $\sum_{n=1}^N a_n n^{-s}$ under the norm
$$\Big\| \sum_{n=1}^N a_n n^{-s} \Big\|_{\mathscr{H}^1} \;=\; \int_{\mathbb{T}^\infty} \Big| \sum_{n=1}^N a_n \chi(n) \Big|\, d\mu(\chi),$$
where $\mathbb{T}^\infty$ is the infinite-dimensional torus equipped with normalized Haar measure $\mu$, and where each character $\chi: \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{T}$ is the completely multiplicative function determined by $\chi(p) = z_p$ (with $z_p$ the coordinate of $\chi$ corresponding to the prime $p$). For each integer $N \geq 1$, define the partial sum of the Riemann zeta function
$$F_N(s) \;=\; \sum_{n=1}^N n^{-s}.$$
Determine whether
$$\| F_N \|_{\mathscr{H}^1} \;=\; o\!\left(\sqrt{N}\right) \qquad \text{as } N \to \infty.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The closely related randomized version, in which $n^{-s}$ is replaced by a Steinhaus random multiplicative function, was resolved by A. Harper, who proved better-than-square-root cancellation $\mathbb{E}\big|\sum_{n\le N} f(n)\big| \asymp \sqrt{N}/(\log\log N)^{1/4}$. However, the deterministic question for $\|F_N\|_{\mathscr{H}^1}$ — i.e., for the average of $|\sum_{n\le N}\chi(n)|$ over all completely multiplicative characters $\chi$ — does not appear to have been resolved; only partial estimates and lower bounds are available, and the problem is still listed as open in surveys of Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series.

status_evidence.title: Moments of random multiplicative functions, I: Low moments, better than squareroot cancellation, and critical multiplicative chaos
status_evidence.snippet: Harper proves E|sum_{n<=x} f(n)| asymp sqrt(x)/(log log x)^{1/4}, confirming better-than-square-root cancellation conjectured by Helson in the random setting.
status_evidence.claim: The randomized version of Helson's conjecture is solved by Harper.

status_evidence.title: Helson's problem for sums of a random multiplicative function (Bondarenko–Seip)
status_evidence.snippet: Lower bounds for small moments of sums of a random multiplicative function as progress toward Helson's conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Prior partial progress focused on the random analogue.

status_evidence.title: Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series and the Riemann zeta function (Seip lecture notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the deterministic H^1 norm of partial sums of zeta and lists the o(sqrt N) question as open.
status_evidence.claim: The deterministic Helson problem about ||F_N||_{H^1} = o(sqrt N) remains open.
